slice: Natural conversation round 16: honest reminder handling (no false promise)
deterministic_honest_reply: Got it — I'll keep that in mind. I can't ping you at a set time in this build, but I'll remember it and bring it up when we talk.
persisted_so_recall_works: I should remember to water the plants

before.remind me to water the plants tomorrow: Sure thing — I'll remind you about the plants tomorrow. (a timed push it cannot actually send)

mechanism: reminder requests are answered honestly (keep in mind, no timed push) and persisted as a recallable fact, instead of over-promising a scheduled alert
